paper_metadata.title: A 21-mW 8-b 125-MSample/s ADC in 0.09-mm2 0.13-m CMOS
authors: Frank M. L. van der Goes
paper_metadata.abstract: This paper presents an 8-b two-step subranging analog-to-digital (ADC) using interpolation, averaging, offset compensation, and pipelining techniques to accomplish an effective number of bits of 7.6 b at 125 MSample/s. The 0.13m CMOS ADC occupies 0.09 mm2 and consumes 21 mW.
